title: Record undocumented receipt request
description: Payload for POST /beta-2/receipts. A consignmentNote is required when any waste item declares hazardous properties; the service checks that, as the rule spans the waste items and the consignment note.

reasonForNoDeliveryId.description: Mandatory explanation for why this receipt is being recorded without a Delivery ID.
examples: No delivery was recorded prior to receipt; waste received directly from the producer.

receiptDateTime.description: When the waste was received at the receiver's site, as an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone. Must not be later than the time the receipt is submitted; the service checks that, as it depends on when the request arrives.

treatments.description: Required on every waste item of a receipt: at least one disposal or recovery operation

consignmentNote.description: The hazardous waste consignment note. Required when any waste item declares hazardous properties.
